productionContracts.proposedSignatures: singletonSources(unit, candidateRoot); validateSingletonBinding(binding, plan, unit, witness, candidateRoot)
productionContracts.identityOwner: Direct source/host/release owner supplies root of the plan being validated; binding validation compares raw journal byte hash with independent plan source map. No Git check duplicated here.
productionContracts.routing: Private canonicalDatabasePrerequisiteSources(candidateRoot) reads only for DB singleton, validates fixed files/physical inventory; no module-load read or context object.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Existing createPlan Git HEAD/clean/AIHR_CI_HEAD checks at EEF15-20 own sha/cwd; pass verified cwd explicitly to both singletonSources calls.
productionContracts.routing: Only invoke canonical inventory if some unit being source-bound is a DB singleton; ordinary DB and NoDB-only planning do not require migration metadata.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Reuse layout returned by its one existing actualSingletonHost(plan,unit,dir); layout.source has real Git head/clean state checked against plan.sha.
productionContracts.routing: Pass layout.source to enumeration and binding validation; do not add a second host/Git observation.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Its existing actualSingletonHost(state.plan,state.unit,state.directory) refreshes verified layout; keep existing private live owner, parent and controller guards.
productionContracts.routing: Use returned layout.source for both calls, require consistency with existing state.layout.source; no new caller JSON can construct live owner.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Existing actual source=realpathSync(process.cwd()), Git HEAD===AIHR_CI_HEAD and clean check; independently execute trusted controller plan in cwd=source and validate host.
productionContracts.routing: Pass that same source to both calls; no roots read from binding, hints, plan JSON or environment override.

productionContracts.proposedSignatures: verifyUnitReport(plan, report, witness, candidateRoot); verifyReports(plan, reports, witness, candidateRoot)
productionContracts.identityOwner: CLI captures explicit candidateRoot once and uses createPlan(candidateRoot); library callers inherit their actual clean-source owner below.
productionContracts.routing: Forward fourth argument unchanged. Require it only for an actual DB-singleton binding; ordinary DB, NoDB and browser report verification remain context-free.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Existing cleanHead(candidatePath), canonical origin/ancestry, createPlan(candidatePath), independently reconstructed expectedPlan, and final source/controller rechecks.
productionContracts.routing: Pass candidatePath/evidence.candidatePath as second argument to validateProof, after existing identity reconstruction; do not extract a new path from report/plan.

productionContracts.identityOwner: verifyCi/revalidateCi own cleanHead; policy retains plan.sha===p.candidate and deep equality with independently reconstructed expectedPlan before forwarding root.
productionContracts.routing: verifyReports(plan,reports,witness,candidateRoot); do not add root to serialized plan/proof/options schema.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Actual summary CLI captures root once then createPlan(candidateRoot), owning clean source/sha; intent/matrix paths only schedule and stay root-free.
productionContracts.routing: Forward fifth argument only when a supplied selected report reaches verification. Empty/missing entries stay missing without requiring journal/root.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Actual release/recovery owner supplies source root; pure assessor checks expectedPlan.sha===expected.candidate and full fingerprint/topology. It is scheduling-only.
productionContracts.routing: Pass fourth argument to verifyUnitReport. Missing root for a present DB-singleton witness is an explicit API refusal outside catch-to-rerun; absent reports need no root.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Actual focused/browser/repair adapter owns clean source and reconstructs expectedPlan before authenticated archive assessment. Pure exported assessor is not a root authenticator.
productionContracts.routing: Forward second argument to both assessResumeCoverage calls. Empty topology preflight stays context-free; never read root from archive/sourceEvidence JSON.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Pure scheduling export has no standalone filesystem owner/CLI. A real caller must supply old root already pinned to sourceEvidence.expectedPlan.sha by its existing source owner.
productionContracts.routing: assessResumeSource(sourceEvidence,sourceCandidateRoot); fresh candidatePlan empty-report topology check stays root-free. No current witness is validated here.

productionContracts.identityOwner: verifyRecoveredCi cleanHead/createPlan(candidatePath) owns exact-source root; existing policy sha/fingerprint/source-run conjunction retained.
productionContracts.routing: Pass fourth argument only to retained report verifyUnitReport calls. Fresh focused NODB packet checks remain unchanged; no new recovery authority.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Existing cleanHead(candidatePath), original archived-plan vs createPlan(candidatePath) equality and final cleanHead checks; exact-source recovery.
productionContracts.routing: Pass candidatePath as second argument to assessResumeSource and verifyFocusedRecovery. Revalidation already re-enters same actual owner.

productionContracts.identityOwner: verifyBrowserRecoveredCi owns actual candidatePath. Existing policy requires originalBody===freshBody excluding controller/fingerprint, hence same source sha for both plans.
productionContracts.routing: Retained source verifyUnitReport receives root; fresh browser-only verifyUnitReport stays context-free. Producer/controller differences do not imply different source root.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Existing cleanHead(candidatePath), planAt(candidatePath,old/new controller,baseline), same-source constraints, final clean source/controller checks.
productionContracts.routing: Pass candidatePath to assessResumeSource and verifyBrowserRecovery; preserve both producer controller identities separately from source root.

productionContracts.identityOwner: verifyRepairedCi owns originalPath and sourcePlan.sha; policy already binds source assessment and retained reports to sourcePlan.
productionContracts.routing: Only retained original verifyUnitReport calls use sourceCandidateRoot. Fresh focused packets keep existing checks; fresh plan is constructed at candidatePath, not substituted for original.

productionContracts.identityOwner: Existing cleanHead BOTH roots at78, sourcePlan=planAt(originalPath) at97, fresh plan=planAt(candidatePath) at101, final identity rechecks at128.
productionContracts.routing: assessResumeSource(originalSourceData,originalPath); verifyRepairRecovery(options,originalPath). Keep candidatePath for fresh plan/build/impact. Never swap roots or add metadata overrides.
